title: Local lower-bound component of pseudo-coherent RHom

proof.text: At x unpack pseudo-coherence to obtain U containing x and a complex P representing K restricted to U, with P^i=0 for i>b. Finite freeness is not needed for this bound-only conjunct.

Exact restriction commutes with derived cohomology, so the lower bound a on L is also a lower bound on L restricted to U. By the canonical derived-category t-structure choose a strictly bounded-below representative G of that restriction.

Apply the bounded-below injective-resolution theorem on the localized ringed site to G. Obtain a quasi-isomorphism G to a K-injective complex I with I^j=0 for j<m. The bound m may differ from a, which suffices for the existential conclusion.

For n<m-b and every p, either p>b, so P^p=0, or p<=b, so p+n<m and I^(p+n)=0. Internal Hom with a zero source or target is zero, by linear-map extensionality. The product cone of homComplex_exists then shows Hom(P,I)^n=0. Thus Hom(P,I) is strictly >=m-b and Q(Hom(P,I)) has zero cohomology below m-b.

The K-injective representative comparison derivedInternalHom_obj_iso computes the local RHom as Q(Hom(P,I)). Use derivedInternalHom_restrict_open and exact restriction of homology to transport this vanishing to the restriction of the global RHom cohomology. Return U and m-b.

proof_origin.place: Clause (1), lower-bound component: direct bounded-above/bounded-below Hom-complex argument with an injective target; open restriction

lean.statement:
theorem rhom_supported_quasiCoherent_pseudo_part_bound
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (K L : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (hL : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X L)
    (hK : Scheme.IsPseudoCoherent X K) (hGE : ∃ a : ℤ, L.IsGE a) :
    ∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ ∃ a : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a →
      IsZero ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj
            ((derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.toRingedSpace)
              X.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj (op K, L))))
